verdict.rationale: Warp is a payroll product, so this axis applies. The evidence mentions payroll handling and an API for listing stored worker bank accounts. Nothing documents paying employees by direct deposit, and nothing mentions next-day or 2-day deposit timing. Stored bank-account records are an adjacent data feature, not evidence of fast direct-deposit pay runs.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay employees by fast (next-day or 2-day) direct deposit instead of writing checks
